title: Trade review 11 Nov: 12 results, 5 lessons
summary: 10 T2, 0 T1, 1 failed: ENGINERSIN +7.53% led the T2 closes; MOTISONS failed −22.63%. Today's closes added +41.6; all 80 closed total +162.0%.
body_md:
**Trade review, Wed 11 Nov:** 10 trades closed at T2, MOTISONS failed at 30 days, TATAINVEST missed.

A strong day: 10 T2 closes made +64.2 points and MOTISONS cost −22.6, so today's 11 closes added +41.6. Nifty rose 0.84% to 25,255.05. All 80 closed trades now total +162.0% (average +2.0%), against +120.4% from 69 on Monday. 22 trades are still running, 12 of them below their buy price, and the average of all 102 bought trades is +1.2%. No new buys today. The next 30-day exits are URBANCO (T1 booked, now +1.1%) on 12 Nov and MOBIKWIK (−7.7%) on 13 Nov.

**Today's results**
- ✅✅ **10 trades hit T2 today and closed:** NMDC +6.00% in 5 days; SUNDARMFIN +6.00% in 7; ATHERENERG +7.30% in 8; RECLTD +6.39% in 12; IDFCFIRSTB +6.01% in 13; WAAREEENER +6.13% in 16 (back from −7.92%); PFC +6.00% in 19; KARURVYSYA +6.80% in 20 (back from −9.33%); TMPV +6.00% in 23 (back from −7.59%); ENGINERSIN +7.53% on its 30th day, back from a −19.50% dip. Seven are candle-at-support picks and three are retests; NMDC, ATHERENERG, RECLTD, PFC and KARURVYSYA all booked T1 on Monday. Together they made +64.2 points.
- ❌ **MOTISONS (Retest, listed 9 Oct): failed at 30 days:** Bought at ₹18.16 on 12 Oct, best rise only 0.8%, closed at ₹14.05, −22.63% (worst −23.29%), 21% below its ₹17.70 support. The listing chart shows an ₹18 stock that had run up about 60% from a June low near ₹11, rose 12% in the month before listing, and was already fading on 0.8× volume, with T1 (₹18.80) and T2 (₹19.30) squeezed just under the ₹19.80 wall. Zone bottom only would have lost −20.62%, no help. It is the 10th retest failure and the 12th failure from a stock that rose 5% or more before listing.
- ⚪ **TATAINVEST (Candle at support, listed 5 Nov): never bought, a missed winner:** It came within 0.85% of the zone top (₹557.28) but never dipped in, then went on to T2. A buy at zone+2% (₹568.43) or at the next open (₹570.15) on 6 Nov would have hit T1 on 9 Nov and T2 today, for +3.92% / +3.61%, small because the buy sits close to the targets.

Plus 55 earlier, among them DIVISLAB, KOTAKBANK, KROSS, BANKINDIA and EMAMILTD (9 Nov) and five partial closes that day. These 65 wins (54 at T2, 11 partial) made +336.2%; with the 15 failures (−174.2% in total, worst MANINDS −24.56%, MOTISONS −22.63% and SMLMAH −18.63%) all 80 closed trades total +162.0%. 7 of the 11 partial 'wins' lost money. T1 booked, rest still open (9): LUPIN (9 Nov), CPPLUS (6 Nov), TATAPOWER (5 Nov), ASTRAL (4 Nov), ONGC (2 Nov), PNGSREVA and ESCORTS (28 Oct), LANDMARK and URBANCO. 3 of these 9 are below their buy price (ASTRAL, ESCORTS, PNGSREVA).

**Missed and better entries**
- **Missed winners now 18 of 30:** TATAINVEST is new tonight. 22 of the 30 never bought came within 2% of the zone.
- **Zone up to 2% higher: more fills, more money:** Fills 93% vs 80% as listed: 13.3 points (the bar is 15). Its 97 closed trades made +194.0%, against +162.0% from 80 as listed, with 20 losing trades against 19.
- **Next day's open: shallower dips and the most money:** Worst dip −6.6% vs −7.7% as listed, 1.2 points shallower (the bar is 2). Its 95 closed trades made +223.7% with 15 losing trades, and its average closed trade is +2.7% against +2.0%. It is still the best rule on money but clears neither fixed bar.
- **Near misses: the real picks caught up on T2 too:** 84 of the 111 room-filter near misses reached T1 (76%) and 58 reached T2 (52%), against 73% and 53% for the real picks after today's ten T2s. The first retest near misses since the change look weak: 10 bought, 2 reached T1, none T2, best rise 1.8%. None is 30 days old yet; money can be compared from about 13 Nov.

**Lessons**
- **Retests fill almost always, but they lose money (now off the list):** Their 31 trades average −3.0% (closed and open), and their 22 closed trades net −64.9% with 10 of the 15 failures, even after three retest T2s today (+21.6%). The retest near misses logged since the change reached T2 0 times in 10. Off the list since 4 Nov. (holding)
- **Stocks that ran up before listing fail most:** Picks that rose 5% or more in the month before listing: 38 trades, 12 of the 15 failures (MOTISONS today), average −3.2%, and their 30 closed trades net −102.6%. Picks that rose less: 64 trades, 3 failures, 41 at T2 (64%), and their 50 closed trades made +264.6%. Second review in a row; it uses my own 5% split, not a tracker group, so it cannot become a change on its own. (holding)
- **Candle-at-support picks are the best group:** 35 of 41 bought reached T1 (85%) and 29 reached T2 (71%); their 31 closed trades made +167.9% with 2 failures, and they have the shallowest dip (−4.3%). (holding)
- **(missed) Support picks that never dip into the zone are often winners:** 18 of 30 never bought would have reached T1 at the next open (TATAINVEST today); 22 of the 30 came within 2% of the zone. Those buys are often close to T1, so the wins are small. (holding)
- **(missed) The room-under-6% filter leaves winners out:** Its near misses now trail the real picks on T2 (52% vs 53%) after leading 51% vs 43% on Monday. None can fail until about 13 Nov, when the money comparison starts. (weakening)
- Still true but out of the top 5: picks already in the buy zone at listing always fill (46 of 46). Very high trigger volume (over 2.5×) fills less often (8 of 14, 57%) and those dip −9.4%. F&O stocks reach T2 more than twice as often as cash stocks (76% vs 32%) and dip far less (−3.4% vs −11.4%).

**Proposed change:** No change tonight. Buying at the next day's open is still the best rule on money (+223.7% vs +162.0%), but its dip gain is 1.2 points against a bar of 2. Zone up to 2% above gets 13.3 points more fills against a bar of 15. The run-up lesson held for a second review, but it rests on my own 5% split rather than a tracker group, and a new filter value cannot be invented, so it stays a lesson. The room-filter money comparison starts about 13 Nov.

**🐞 Bug check:** nothing new. 102 bought = 54 at T2 + 11 partial + 15 failed + 22 running; T1 hit 74 ≥ T2 hit 54; no dates out of order; no duplicates; every closed return matches its fill and exit; no price revisions against Monday's log and no closed row changed. The 7 losing 'wins' are partial closes scored as designed.
